packageRules.description: Override the 3-day npm minimumReleaseAge from config:best-practices
A convex update can change the committed _generated code, and codegen needs a Convex deployment, so Renovate can't regenerate it: open a separate PR without automerge
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Before merging, run `pnpm build:codegen` on this branch and commit any changes under `src/component/_generated/`.

packageRules.description: Ship every new @gramio/types (Telegram Bot API types) version as a convex-telegram release: its own fix(deps) PR that raises the range, 3 days after publish, outside the weekend schedule
Automerge @gramio/types minor and patch updates so they reach the release PR
A new Bot API major version opens a feat(deps) PR for review, without dashboard approval
